questions.explanation: The ddtrace.trace.Context object is used to represent the state of a trace at a point in time. This state includes the trace id, active span id, distributed sampling decision and more. It is used to propagate the trace across execution boundaries like processes ( Distributed Tracing ), threads and tasks.
